This millet plot is my own land, so I will put some manure and a small amount of fertilizer, but I will not spend too much cash because millet can still give me something even when the season is not perfect. I will keep my local seed because that is what I trust on this plot, and since this is rainfed in our area, I will wait for the rains and use mostly family labor with a few hired hands at the busy time.
